recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-32979 unless future semantic changes to questionnaire-itemControl guidance are desired; those should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than this core checkout.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire clarification asking for the questionnaire-itemControl extension description to explain that conflicting or unsupported item controls may be ignored by form fillers and that authoring tools may warn or prohibit invalid control choices.
initial_application: Jira points to git commit 9a7750a73e, which added the requested repeats=true radio-button example, Attachment slider example, form-filler ignore behavior, and form-authoring validation guidance to source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-extension-questionnaire-itemControl.xml for R5.
additional_context: The current core build still includes Questionnaire as an active resource, but the questionnaire-itemControl StructureDefinition is no longer an active core source artifact. Core commit dd468d4f17 removed this Questionnaire extension family from R5 source during the extension-source ownership change. The FHIR Extension Pack now contains the authoritative questionnaire-itemControl definition and preserves the FHIR-32979 guidance. FHIR-5956 was already audited on the combined branch with the same ownership conclusion for this layout-extension family.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The requested guidance is already present in the current Extension Pack artifact, and recreating or editing the extension definition in core would conflict with the current source ownership model.

related_jiras.note: Prior combined-branch audit of Questionnaire layout extension ownership, confirming questionnaire-itemControl is maintained in the Extension Pack rather than active core source.
